description: Repo Scout reads YouTube repo channels and lists every repo and tool a video covers. Baseline sends the full captions to the model; the candidates send only the caption chunks Jev says name a tool (jev-filter: at or above 0.5 with one neighbor each side; jev-strict: at or above 0.75, no neighbors). full-repeat is the baseline run twice, the noise floor.

variants.name: full
variants.description: Production today: description plus the whole transcript (capped at 45,000 characters), one standard-level call with the production prompt.

variants.name: jev-filter
variants.description: Same prompt and model; the transcript first goes through Jev in 700-character chunks, keeping chunks scored at or above 0.5 plus 1 neighbor on each side and always the first two.

variants.name: jev-strict
variants.description: Same prompt and model; the transcript first goes through Jev in 700-character chunks, keeping chunks scored at or above 0.75 and always the first two.

variants.name: full-repeat
variants.description: The baseline run a second time on the same inputs. Its distance from full is the noise floor: any candidate change smaller than this is not evidence.

checks.description: The reply parsed as the Extraction schema within two attempts
Every repo linked in the description is named by the model before the merge backfills it
Every repo or tool production recorded for this video appears in this variant's items (matched by URL, key or name, no network)
Every item category is in the allowed set
No em dash in any output text
